items.title: Jessie Charles Interview, 1967-12-15
items.q: He was my homeboy quite nice. He used to take me around and when we'd go in places like that, he'd say, well this is my clarinet player. I didn't even know how to play at that time, but he would just tell the people that they'd get me in.

ctx.x: Did they play in the Red Light District though? Did you ever see them down there?

Kid Punching them? No, I never saw them down there. I used to see Willie Irmfree, I used to see them at the Larrick Cabaret. I used to go to the Larrick Cabaret. They had the old Larrick Theater down in the street. They used to have what you call Larrick Cabaret. They had a cabaret down below underneath the theater. They had a nightclub called Cabaret. I remember Willie Irmfree, Punch taking me there. The first time I went there, Punch taking me there. He was my homeboy quite nice. He used to take me around and…
You know, we forgot to ask him something, what he played when he was in the brass bands.
